items.title: Implement experience-hint-loader: load, rank, filter, format top-N hints
items.context: core/experience-hint-loader.ts: read finding-signals.json via learning-store; rank by priority = signalScore*log(1+support)*recencyBoost; recurring-issue hints require signalScore>=0.65; low-score+high-false-positive => common_false_positive hints; top-N (<=3 recurring + 2 false-positive) with progressive disclosure (summary first). Zero outward imports except learning-store (read-only) + types.
items.userSees: The smoke asserts the loader returns ranked top-N hints with correct priority ordering, the score-threshold filter, the common-false-positive bucket, and support shown alongside score.

happy.desc: loadExperienceHints with 5 recurring signals (scores 0.9, 0.8, 0.7, 0.66, 0.5) + 3 false-positive signals -> returns top-3 recurring (score>=0.65 only, so 0.5 excluded) + top-2 false-positive, ordered by priority=signalScore*log(1+support)*recencyBoost descending; WHY: covers main ranking formula, score threshold, bucket caps, and top-N truncation

Each returned hint includes progressive disclosure format: summary line with score + support + source shown, full detail not expanded by default; WHY: verifies progressive disclosure output requirement
Low-score + high-false-positive signals are classified into common_false_positive bucket, not recurring bucket; WHY: verifies the two-bucket classification logic

edge.desc: One-hit high-score signal (score=0.95, support=1) vs many-hit moderate signal (score=0.7, support=50) -> many-hit signal ranks higher because log(1+50)*0.7 >> log(1+1)*0.95; WHY: proves log(1+support) damping prevents one-hit wonders from dominating
Exactly 3 recurring + exactly 2 false-positive signals -> all returned (at cap boundary); 4 recurring + 3 fp -> lowest-priority from each bucket dropped; WHY: boundary test at top-N caps
All signals have signalScore < 0.65 and low falsePositiveRate -> zero recurring hints, zero fp hints -> empty result; WHY: no signal qualifies for either bucket
Signal with signalScore exactly 0.65 -> included in recurring (boundary inclusive); signal at 0.6499 -> excluded; WHY: threshold boundary precision
Signals with identical priority scores -> stable deterministic sort order; WHY: prevents non-deterministic flicker in hint ordering

adversarial.desc: Import-fence: grep experience-hint-loader.ts imports and assert only learning-store + experience-layer-types + node: builtins; then inject a forbidden import and re-scan -> now detected; WHY: non-vacuous import-fence test proves the scan catches real violations
finding-signals.json contains malformed/truncated JSON -> loader returns empty hints gracefully without throwing; WHY: file corruption resilience
finding-signals.json contains a signal with NaN signalScore -> that signal excluded, other valid signals still returned; WHY: invalid numeric input handling
finding-signals.json missing (file not found) -> loader returns empty hints, no crash; WHY: cold-start scenario with no signals yet

items.title: Surface hints as an advisory section in story-review (mirror grillSection)
items.context: handlers/story-review.ts: add an experienceHintsSection (advisory only) into the _reviewPrompt advisory output, mirroring grillSection placement, sourced from experience-hint-loader. Clearly labelled 'Project experience hints (advisory only)'. Advisory-only; does not change any gate.
items.userSees: story_review output _reviewPrompt includes a 'Project experience hints (advisory only)' section when signals exist; absent/empty when there are none.

happy.desc: story_review with signals present -> _reviewPrompt contains a section labelled Project experience hints (advisory only) with hint content from the loader; WHY: covers the main integration path
story_review with zero signals -> _reviewPrompt does NOT contain the experience hints section; WHY: verifies omission when no signals exist

edge.desc: story_review with exactly 1 signal -> advisory section present with exactly 1 hint entry; WHY: minimum non-empty boundary
Advisory section placement mirrors grillSection placement in _reviewPrompt (appears in same relative position/pattern); WHY: verifies mirror-grillSection structural requirement

adversarial.desc: Signals contain special characters (newlines, markdown injection, backticks, angle brackets) -> advisory section renders without breaking the surrounding prompt structure; WHY: prompt injection resilience
Advisory section is clearly advisory-only: no gate logic references the hint content, no conditional gate pass/fail depends on hints; WHY: ensures hints cannot accidentally become blockers

items.title: Usage tracking + promptHash determinism guardrail
items.context: Surfacing writes an experience_hint_surfaced event (storyId, hintIds) to the activity log via appendActivityLog. GUARDRAIL: resolveReviewPromptHash (core/review-run.ts) must remain independent of experience hints — hint content must never feed the reviewRunId promptHash domain.
items.userSees: The smoke asserts an experience_hint_surfaced event is appended when hints surface, and that resolveReviewPromptHash output is identical regardless of experience-hint content (deterministic reviewRunId binding unaffected).
